as_told.title: Contractor sees craft hovering in Dugway building

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells a story he heard from a contractor he calls only "MS", who was reading electric meters at Dugway Proving Ground, a US Army testing range in the Utah desert. According to UAPGerb, MS walked into a building in a remote part of the base called Avery and saw a craft that seemed to be in the middle of being taken apart. If true, it would point to unusual craft being studied in secret on military land.
